data.name: SMSTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT 
    MID, Mobile, MessageID, KeywordID, CodeID, Sent, Undelivered, CreateDateTime, ActionDateTime, IsTest
    MobileMessageTrackingID, MobileMessageRecurrenceID, IsValid, InvalidationCode, SendID, SendSplitID, SendJobID, 
    SubscriberKey, SubscriberID, SMSJobID, Name, JBActivityID, JBDefinitionID, Description, Delivered,
    
    /* Convert CST → UTC first */
    DATEADD(
      HOUR,
      6 +
      CASE
        WHEN
          /* AEDT window */
          DATEADD(HOUR, 6, ActionDateTime) >=
            DATEADD(
              DAY,
              (7 - DATEPART(
                     WEEKDAY,
                     CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, ActionDateTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-10-01'
                   )) % 7,
              CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, ActionDateTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-10-01'
            )
          AND
          DATEADD(HOUR, 6, ActionDateTime) <
            DATEADD(
              DAY,
              (7 - DATEPART(
                     WEEKDAY,
                     CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, ActionDateTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-04-01'
                   )) % 7,
              CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, ActionDateTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-04-01'
            )
        THEN 11  /* AEDT */
        ELSE 10  /* AEST */
      END,
      ActionDateTime
    ) AS ActionDateTime_Local
    
FROM _smsmessagetracking 
WHERE IsTest = 0
AND ActionDateTime >= DateAdd(DD, -360, GETDATE())

data.name: Aggregate_SMSTracking_Daily
data.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(ActionDateTime_Local AS DATE) AS AggDate,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN Sent = 1 
        THEN CONCAT(SubscriberKey, '_', CAST(MessageID AS CHAR))
    END) AS ContactsSent,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN Delivered = 1 
        THEN CONCAT(SubscriberKey, '_', CAST(MessageID AS CHAR))
    END) AS ContactsDelivered,

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN Undelivered = 1 
        THEN CONCAT(SubscriberKey, '_', CAST(MessageID AS CHAR))
    END) AS ContactsUndelivered, 

    COUNT(CASE WHEN Sent = 1 THEN 1 END) AS SMSSent,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Delivered = 1 THEN 1 END) AS SMSDelivered,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Undelivered = 1 THEN 1 END) AS SMSUndelivered

FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/8c5c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/8c5c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}]

GROUP BY 
    CAST(ActionDateTime_Local AS DATE)

data.name: Job_EmailTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT
    j.JobID,
    j.EmailName,
    j.DeliveredTime,
    
    /* Convert CST → UTC first */
    DATEADD(
      HOUR,
      6 +
      CASE
        WHEN
          /* AEDT window */
          DATEADD(HOUR, 6, DeliveredTime) >=
            DATEADD(
              DAY,
              (7 - DATEPART(
                     WEEKDAY,
                     CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, DeliveredTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-10-01'
                   )) % 7,
              CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, DeliveredTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-10-01'
            )
          AND
          DATEADD(HOUR, 6, DeliveredTime) <
            DATEADD(
              DAY,
              (7 - DATEPART(
                     WEEKDAY,
                     CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, DeliveredTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-04-01'
                   )) % 7,
              CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(HOUR, 6, DeliveredTime)) AS VARCHAR) + '-04-01'
            )
        THEN 11  /* AEDT */
        ELSE 10  /* AEST */
      END,
      DeliveredTime
    ) AS DeliveredTime_Local,

    j.JobType,
    j.EmailSubject,
    j.Category,
    j.SuppressTracking,
    j.SendClassificationType,
    j.SendClassification,
    j.EmailSendDefinition,
    j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID,
    j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey

FROM [_Job] j

WHERE j.SuppressTracking = 0

data.name: Aggregate_Sent_EmailTracking_Daily
data.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(s.EventDate_Local AS DATE) AS AggDate,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalSent,
    
    /* Journey Builder sends */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS JBSent,

    /* Triggered Sends (non-JB) */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NOT NULL AND ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS TSSent,
    
    /*  User Initiated Sends */
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UISent
    
    
FROM
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/885c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/885c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] s
INNER JOIN
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] j
    ON s.JobId = j.JobId
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT JourneyActivityObjectID
    FROM _JourneyActivity
    WHERE JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL
    
) ja
ON j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID = ja.JourneyActivityObjectID

WHERE
    s.EventDate_Local IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CAST(s.EventDate_Local AS DATE)

data.name: Sent_EmailTracking
data.queryText:
SELECT j.jobid,
       s.eventdate,
       s.subscriberid,
       s.subscriberkey,
       s.triggerersenddefinitionobjectid,
       s.triggeredsendcustomerkey,
       Dateadd(hour, 6 + CASE WHEN Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate) >=
                     Dateadd(
                     day, (7
                     - Datepart(
                     weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6, s.eventdate))
                     AS
                     VARCHAR) +
                     '-10-01' )) % 7, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour, 6,
                     s.eventdate))
                     AS
                     VARCHAR) + '-10-01' ) AND Dateadd(hour, 6,
                     s.eventdate) <
                     Dateadd(
                     day, (7 - Datepart( weekday, Cast(Year(Dateadd(hour
                     , 6,
                     s.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) + '-04-01' )) % 7, Cast(
                     Year(
                     Dateadd(
                     hour, 6,
                     s.eventdate)) AS VARCHAR) + '-04-01' ) THEN 11 ELSE
                     10 END
                     , s.eventdate)
               AS EventDate_Local
        FROM   {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] j

data.name: Prepare_Email_SentTrend_Last30
data.queryText:
SELECT
  ej.EmailName,
  CONCAT(
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 6 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 7 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 8 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 9 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 10 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 11 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 12 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 13 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 14 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 15 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 16 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 17 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 18 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 19 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 20 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 21 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 22 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 23 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 24 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 25 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 26 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 27 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 28 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 29 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END),
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 30 THEN ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ej.Sent, 0) AS VARCHAR) ELSE '' END)
  ) AS SentTrendLast30
FROM (
  SELECT
    EmailName,
    Sent,
    JobId,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EmailName ORDER BY DeliveredTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] WHERE EmailName != ''
) ej
WHERE rn <= 30
GROUP BY ej.EmailName

        WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NOT NULL AND ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS TSClick,
    
    /*  User Initiated Sends */
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UIClick
    
FROM
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/825c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/825c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] c
INNER JOIN
    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/865c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] j
    ON c.JobId = j.JobId
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT JourneyActivityObjectID
    FROM _JourneyActivity
    WHERE JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL
) ja
ON j.TriggererSendDefinitionObjectID = ja.JourneyActivityObjectID

WHERE
    c.EventDate_Local IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    CAST(c.EventDate_Local AS DATE)

data.name: Aggregate_Unsub_EmailTracking_Daily
data.queryText:
SELECT
    CAST(u.EventDate_Local AS DATE) AS AggDate,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalUnsub,
    
    /* Journey Builder sends */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NOT NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0

    /* Triggered Sends (non-JB) */
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NOT NULL AND ja.JourneyActivityObjectID IS NULL 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS TSUnsub,
    
    /*  User Initiated Sends */
    SUM(CASE WHEN j.TriggeredSendCustomerKey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UIUnsub

    {{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/835c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/namePrefix}}[{{mcpm#/entities/dataExtensions/835c6f75-b7ce-f111-a5c4-5cba2c7b2f40/data/name}}] u
